Beginner.learningGoal: Implement 2D vector operations and a simple rectangle overlap test.
gotchas: Touching edges: decide whether < or <= and document it
Normalising a zero vector divides by zero (nan or inf)
Floating point comparisons need an epsilon
goodSolutionShows: Vec2 functions that return new tables without mutating inputs
AABB overlap using separate axis checks
shapeHints: add, scale, length and normalise for a player's velocity
a point inside rectangle check for UI hit testing

Intermediate.learningGoal: Resolve AABB collisions: penetration depth, minimum translation and swept movement along axes.
gotchas: Resolving both axes at once causes sticking in corners; resolve axis by axis
The sign of the push-out depends on which side the overlap is smaller
Tunnelling at high speed when moving more than a tile per step
goodSolutionShows: Penetration on each axis with the smaller one chosen
Deterministic results for exact edge contact
shapeHints: a player rectangle moving against tile walls
push-out resolution for two overlapping boxes
a simple platformer step with gravity (dt passed in)

Advanced.learningGoal: Implement swept AABB or ray-vs-box tests returning time of impact and normal.
gotchas: Division by zero for axis-parallel rays should use huge values, not nan
Time of impact must be clamped to [0, 1]
goodSolutionShows: Slab method for ray vs box
Returning t and the surface normal
Tests with grazing and parallel cases
shapeHints: a bullet that must not tunnel through a thin wall
a ray from a character's eyes hitting boxes
a sliding response along a wall after impact
